name: Sun Cleric: Glorious Execution returns 5% of its damage as mana credited to Glorious Execution 807552 (#9590)
contract: Glorious Execution 800626 reads 'regenerate mana equal to $807451s1% of the damage dealt'; 807451 effect 0 is bp 4 +
DieSides 1 = 5. Its mana-return spell 807552 'Glorious Execution' is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE ('Restores $807451s1% of
the damage dealt by Glorious Execution as mana'), and live combat logs credit every return to 807552. The server
granted the right amount from each main-hand (800691) or off-hand (802566) strike, but sent it as 504877 'Vow of
Grace' through the shared Mana() helper, so the combat log never showed Glorious Execution mana. With one polearm and
no off-hand weapon only the main-hand strike lands; its 807552 energize must be 5% of the damage (floored per hit).
